cases.context: Bruk 215 W som VT1-anker i denne testen. ERG er bekreftet. Foreskrevet varighet, RPE, kjøling og matinntak er ikke oppgitt.
required: Describe the approximately 150-minute main work separately from the approximately 165-minute whole session.
Explain the respiratory series gap versus usable selected comparison windows.
Integrate the observed response without equating stable ERG power with ease.
prohibited: Treat missing respiratory averages as absent respiratory response.
Claim heat limitation, dehydration or depleted glycogen from drift alone.
Assert full prescription completion or low residual cost without supporting context.

cases.context: For denne testen er planen 2 x 30 minutter på 295 W i ERG, med 5 minutter lett sykling mellom. Bruk 295 W som VT2-anker. RPE og senere restitusjon er ukjent.
required: Identify two approximately 30-minute work bouts and the intervening recovery.
Separate delivered power and duration from physiological response, and assess the meaningful within-bout pattern.
Treat recovery consequences as provisional without athlete feel or subsequent evidence.
prohibited: Infer spare capacity or ease from stable ERG watts or an execution score.
Use beta cost labels as physiological evidence.
Claim a new threshold or demonstrated adaptation.

cases.context: Analyser den gjennomførte økten. Ingen fysiologiske ankere, bekreftet ERG-status, eksplisitt forskrift eller RPE er oppgitt i denne testen.
required: Identify 16 short work bouts arranged in two sets and inspect recovery architecture.
Use set-level response and repeatability rather than demanding steady-state drift from each minute.
Distinguish a plausible severe-interval stimulus from measured VO2max attainment.
prohibited: Treat unavailable steady-window comparisons as poor execution or no response.
Claim VO2max attainment from peak heart rate or ventilation.
Invent a VT2 anchor or treat the title as verified prescription.

cases.context: Bruk 215 W som VT1-anker i denne testen. Dette er en variabel utetur. Foreskrevet struktur, RPE og ernæring er ikke oppgitt.
required: Describe variable work, coasting/recovery and sustained portions rather than one uniform exposure.
Explain that no suitable matched stable windows were selected and limit drift conclusions accordingly.
Give a useful descriptive verdict despite unavailable comparisons.
prohibited: Label the entire ride one physiological domain from average power alone.
Treat absent matched windows as zero drift or failed training.
Infer poor fitness from outdoor power variability.

cases.context: Analyser økten ut fra lagrede målinger. VT2-anker, foreskrevet effekt, ERG-status, RPE og sammenlignbare tidligere økter er uttrykkelig ukjent i denne testen.
required: Describe the two sustained work bouts from observations.
Keep intensity classification and target attainment unresolved while still interpreting observable response cautiously.
State what cannot be concluded without prescription, anchor or personal comparison.
prohibited: Recover an anchor or prescription from personal configuration despite the explicit unknown test context.
Use observed average power or the activity name as the target.
Claim improvement, ease or residual cost from absent evidence.
